$comment: Single source of truth for the workflow templates. docs/workflow-templates.md and workflows/README.md are generated from it by `npm run docs:templates`.

templates.title: Make your first AI phone call from n8n with Ringee
templates.description: Places one AI voice call from a button click, waits two minutes and reads the result. The fastest way to see Ringee working in n8n.
templates.businessUseCase: Prove the integration end to end before building anything: credentials, agent, call, result.
templates.audience: Anyone installing the Ringee node for the first time.
ringeeFeatures: AI Voice Agent: Get Call Result
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
A phone number you control, for the test call.
configuration: Open the two Ringee nodes and select your Ringee API credential.
In Start AI call, pick your agent and replace the sample number with your own.
Click Execute workflow and answer the call.
templates.sampleData: Sample number +14155550123 (fictional). Variables: first_name = Alex, notification = a quick test.
templates.errorHandling: A refused call (no credits, Do-Not-Call number, invalid number) stops the run with an explanation; nothing is dialed.
templates.expectedResults: Your phone rings. Two minutes later the last node shows status, outcome and the AI summary.

templates.title: AI appointment reminder calls with Ringee, Google Calendar and n8n
templates.description: An AI voice agent phones each person about an hour before a meeting to confirm they will attend, then the meeting is colour-coded in Google Calendar: green for confirmed, red for cannot attend, yellow for a person to follow up.
templates.businessUseCase: Cut no-shows for demos, consultations, viewings and appointments by confirming by phone, without anyone on your team making the calls.
templates.audience: Sales teams, clinics, agencies and service businesses that book meetings in Google Calendar.
ringeeFeatures: AI Voice Agent: Start Call (with an Idempotency Key per meeting)
Ringee Trigger: Call Completed and Call Failed
AI Voice Agent: Get Call Result
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
A Google Calendar whose events carry the guest’s phone number in the description (Phone: +14155550123).
An AI voice agent of type Reminders & Notifications.
configuration: Create the Ringee API credential and select it on the four Ringee nodes; pick your agent in Start reminder call.
Select your calendar on the three Google Calendar nodes and connect Google Calendar.
Activate the workflow, then paste the Ringee Trigger Production URL into your Custom Integration as the Outbound URL and tick Call Completed and Call Failed.
Add Phone: and Name: lines to your event descriptions.
templates.sampleData: The Ringee Trigger carries a pinned sample call.completed event (external ID reminder-sampleEventId123) so you can test the second half without waiting for a call.
templates.errorHandling: Events without a phone number are skipped. The same meeting never gets two calls (Idempotency Key = calendar event ID). If the AI analysis is not ready after seven minutes the workflow stops quietly and the call stays visible in Ringee. A number Ringee rejects (for example on the Do-Not-Call list) goes to its own output and the rest of the batch is still called.
templates.expectedResults: About an hour before each meeting the guest receives a call; shortly after it ends the event changes colour in Google Calendar.

templates.title: Qualify new leads with an AI phone call from Google Sheets using Ringee
templates.description: Every new row in a leads sheet gets a call from an AI voice agent that asks your qualifying questions; the row is updated with the outcome, summary and sentiment.
templates.businessUseCase: Speed to lead without an SDR: every inbound lead is contacted within minutes and the sheet always shows who was reached and what they said.
templates.audience: Agencies and small sales teams that collect leads in Google Sheets.
ringeeFeatures: Ringee Trigger: Call Completed and Call Failed
AI Voice Agent: Get Call Result
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
A sheet with columns Name, Phone, Company, Status, Outcome, Summary, Sentiment.
An AI voice agent of type Appointment Booking configured with your qualifying questions.
configuration: Select your Ringee credential and agent.
Choose the same spreadsheet and sheet on the three Google Sheets nodes.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL.
templates.sampleData: Pinned sample call.completed event with external ID lead-2 (row 2 of the sheet).
templates.errorHandling: Rows without a phone number, or that already have a Status, are skipped. A row is marked “Calling” right after the call starts so it is not called twice. The Idempotency Key is the row number plus the phone number, so a reused row is not mistaken for an earlier lead. A number Ringee rejects goes to its own output and the other rows are still called. If the AI analysis is not ready after seven minutes the row says "Analysis pending" instead of claiming a result.
templates.expectedResults: New rows are called; when the call ends, Outcome, Summary and Sentiment are filled in.

templates.title: Follow up on missed meetings with an AI voice call and HubSpot
templates.description: When a prospect misses a meeting, an AI voice agent phones them ten minutes later and offers a new time; when a new meeting is booked it is logged on the HubSpot contact.
templates.businessUseCase: Recover no-shows while the conversation is still warm, without chasing them by hand.
templates.audience: Sales teams that book demos through a scheduling tool and keep records in HubSpot.
requiredIntegrations: A scheduling tool that can send a webhook on a no-show
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
An AI voice agent of type Appointment Booking with your calendar connected in Ringee.
Something that tells n8n about a no-show (Calendly, Cal.com, Zoom, your CRM).
configuration: In n8n create a Header Auth credential (a header name such as X-Webhook-Secret and a long random value) and select it on the webhook node; make your scheduling tool send the same header. Without it the workflow will not activate.
Point your scheduling tool’s no-show webhook at this workflow’s Meeting was missed URL, sending name, phone, email, meeting and meetingId.
Select your Ringee credential and agent, and connect HubSpot.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL and tick Meeting Created.
templates.sampleData: Webhook body {"name":"Ada Lovelace","phone":"+14155550123","email":"ada@example.com","meeting":"Product demo","meetingId":"mtg_123"}; pinned sample meeting.created event.
templates.errorHandling: Each missed meeting is called once (Idempotency Key = meeting ID). If HubSpot has no contact with that phone number nothing is logged. Only a caller that sends the secret header can start a call; anything else is refused before any number is read.
templates.expectedResults: The prospect is called about ten minutes after the no-show; a rebooked meeting appears as a meeting on the HubSpot contact.
templates.dependsOnUnavailable: Ringee does not detect no-shows. The trigger is a webhook you send from another tool.

templates.title: Call Facebook Lead Ads leads in minutes with a Ringee AI voice agent
templates.description: A new Facebook lead is phoned by an AI voice agent straight away and, when the form gave an email, the lead is created or updated in HubSpot.
templates.businessUseCase: Contact paid-ad leads while they still remember the ad, when conversion is highest.
templates.audience: Marketing teams and agencies running Facebook and Instagram lead ads.
ringeeFeatures: Ringee Trigger: Call Completed and Call Failed
AI Voice Agent: Get Call Result
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
A lead form that asks for a phone number and for consent to be called.
configuration: Choose your Facebook page and form on the trigger.
Select the Ringee credential and agent; connect HubSpot.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL.
templates.sampleData: Pinned sample call.completed event with external ID fb-sample-lead-1.
templates.errorHandling: Leads without a phone number are skipped. Each lead is called once (Idempotency Key = lead ID). A lead without an email is called but not saved to HubSpot, so no placeholder contact is ever written.
templates.expectedResults: A new lead gets a call within about a minute; when it ends the contact is created or updated in HubSpot. The call and its summary stay in Ringee.

templates.title: Call every new HubSpot contact with a Ringee AI voice agent and log the call
templates.description: A contact created in HubSpot is called by an AI voice agent and the call is logged on the contact with the AI’s summary.
templates.businessUseCase: Warm every new contact immediately and keep the CRM timeline complete without manual logging.
templates.audience: Teams whose lead intake lands in HubSpot (forms, imports, integrations).
ringeeFeatures: Ringee Trigger: Call Completed and Call Failed
AI Voice Agent: Get Call Result
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
Contacts with a phone number, who agreed to be called.
configuration: Connect HubSpot on the trigger and the HubSpot nodes.
Select the Ringee credential and agent.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL.
templates.sampleData: Pinned sample call.completed event with external ID hs-501 (HubSpot contact 501).
templates.errorHandling: Contacts without a phone are skipped; each contact is called once (Idempotency Key = contact ID). A number Ringee rejects goes to its own output and the rest of the batch is still called. If the AI analysis is not ready after seven minutes the call is logged as "analysis pending", with its real status (completed, busy, failed or no answer).
templates.expectedResults: The contact receives a call; a call activity with the outcome and summary appears on their HubSpot timeline.

templates.title: Call back missed calls automatically with a Ringee AI voice agent
templates.description: When an inbound call goes unanswered, an AI voice agent calls the person back five minutes later and the callback is logged in a Google Sheet.
templates.businessUseCase: Never lose a caller because nobody picked up; every missed call gets a prompt, polite callback.
templates.audience: Small businesses, clinics and agencies with unstaffed hours.
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
A sheet “Callback log” with columns Time, Caller, Our number, Callback call, Reason.
configuration: Select the Ringee credential and agent.
Choose your spreadsheet and sheet on the Google Sheets node.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL and tick Call Missed.
templates.errorHandling: A caller is called back at most once every four hours (Idempotency Key = the caller’s number and the four-hour window), so repeated calls are not answered with repeated calls and two Ringee numbers running this workflow cannot call each other forever.
templates.expectedResults: Five minutes after a missed call the caller receives a call from your AI agent and a row is added to the log.

templates.title: Notify your team about every AI receptionist call with a structured summary
templates.description: When an AI receptionist call ends, the workflow reads what the AI learned and posts a clean record (who, why, urgency, callback number, summary) to Slack.
templates.businessUseCase: Nobody has to listen to recordings: the team sees who called and what they need.
templates.audience: Businesses using the Ringee AI receptionist for incoming calls.
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
An AI receptionist agent assigned to a number in Ringee.
configuration: Select the Ringee credential and connect Slack; choose the channel.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL and tick Call Completed.
Tell your receptionist what to collect (name, reason, urgency, callback number).
templates.sampleData: Pinned sample inbound call.completed event from +14155550123.
templates.errorHandling: Outbound calls are skipped. A missing field falls back to a readable default. If the AI analysis is not ready after seven minutes the team is told so, with urgency "unknown", instead of being told the call was normal.
templates.expectedResults: A message in your Slack channel within a few minutes of each receptionist call.

templates.title: Call new GoHighLevel leads with a Ringee AI voice agent and update the opportunity
templates.description: A GoHighLevel workflow sends each new lead to n8n; an AI voice agent calls them and the opportunity is marked lost or kept open.
templates.businessUseCase: Add AI phone follow-up to GoHighLevel pipelines without changing how leads arrive.
templates.audience: Agencies and teams running their pipeline in GoHighLevel.
ringeeFeatures: Ringee Trigger: Call Completed and Call Failed
AI Voice Agent: Get Call Result
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
A GoHighLevel workflow with a Webhook action that posts the lead to n8n.
configuration: In n8n create a Header Auth credential (a header name such as X-Webhook-Secret and a long random value) and select it on the webhook node; make the GoHighLevel webhook action send the same header. Without it the workflow will not activate.
Add the webhook action in GoHighLevel with name, phone, email and opportunityId.
Select the Ringee credential and agent; connect HighLevel and choose a stage.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL.
templates.errorHandling: Each opportunity is called once (Idempotency Key = opportunity ID). Only a caller that sends the secret header can start a call; anything else is refused before any number is read. If the AI analysis is not ready after seven minutes the opportunity is left as it is.
templates.expectedResults: The lead is called; the opportunity status is updated when the call ends.

templates.title: Post call summaries and transcripts to Slack automatically with Ringee
templates.description: When a recording is ready, the AI summary and the start of the transcript are posted to Slack.
templates.businessUseCase: Keep the team informed about customer conversations without anyone opening Ringee.
templates.audience: Sales and support teams that review calls.
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
Call recording enabled in Ringee. Post only to a private channel and follow your recording-consent rules.
configuration: Select the Ringee credential and connect Slack; choose a private channel.
Activate, then set the Ringee Trigger Production URL as the integration’s Outbound URL and tick Recording Ready.
templates.sampleData: Pinned sample recording.ready event that already contains a transcript.
templates.errorHandling: If the transcript is not in the event, the workflow waits three minutes and fetches it. Only the first 700 characters are posted.
templates.expectedResults: A Slack message with the summary and transcript excerpt for every recorded call.
templates.dependsOnUnavailable: Ringee has no separate “transcript ready” event; the transcript arrives with Recording Ready.

templates.title: AI agent that makes phone calls with Ringee tools in n8n
templates.description: A chat-driven n8n AI Agent that can find contacts, start AI voice calls, read call results and fetch transcripts through Ringee tools, and asks for confirmation before every call.
templates.businessUseCase: Let a teammate say “call Ada about tomorrow’s demo” in chat and have it done, safely.
templates.audience: Teams building AI assistants and automation agencies.
requiredIntegrations: An LLM provider (OpenAI in the template)
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and at least one AI voice agent (Ringee → AI Voice Agents).
A Ringee Custom Integration (Integrations → Custom Integrations) for the API key and Signing Secret.
The Ringee community node installed in n8n (Settings → Community nodes → n8n-nodes-ringee).
Self-hosted n8n: N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE=true.
An OpenAI (or other chat model) credential.
configuration: Select the Ringee credential on all four tools and pick the agent in Start call.
Select your chat model credential.
Open the chat and try “Call Ada Lovelace to confirm tomorrow’s demo”.
templates.sampleData: Chat message: “Call +14155550123 and ask Alex if the delivery arrived.” (fictional number)
templates.errorHandling: The agent must get an explicit “yes” before calling. Delete operations are not offered to AI agents. Refusals (credits, Do-Not-Call) are explained, not retried.
templates.expectedResults: The assistant confirms, starts the call, returns the call ID and later reports the outcome.

templates.title: AI appointment reminder with plain HTTP Request nodes (no community node needed)
templates.description: The appointment reminder built only from n8n’s built-in HTTP Request nodes, for n8n Cloud and for trying Ringee before installing the community node.
templates.businessUseCase: Use Ringee from n8n Cloud today, or experiment without installing anything.
templates.audience: n8n Cloud users and anyone evaluating Ringee.
prerequisites: A Ringee account with credits and an AI voice agent of type Reminders & Notifications.
A Ringee Custom Integration API key.
configuration: Create a Header Auth credential: name X-Ringee-Api-Key, value your cik_live_ key.
Replace YOUR_AGENT_ID in the URL of the first HTTP Request node.
Select your calendar on the Google Calendar nodes.
templates.sampleData: Calendar event description: “Phone: +14155550123 / Name: Ada Lovelace”.
templates.errorHandling: Same protection against double calls as the Ringee-node version. It reads the result by waiting five minutes instead of using a trigger, so it needs no public webhook.
templates.expectedResults: Same as template 01, without the Ringee community node.
